messages:
Emma Chen: quick sync — prepping the midmarket tier launch checklist. primary asks from SALES: clear burst behavior, optional priority lane add-on, and a simple SLA uplift path. can we map these to must-have vs nice-to-have?
Ajay Patel: must-have = documented burst policy + billing behavior. customers are asking 'how long can they burst' and 'how are we charging overages'.
Marco Ruiz: +1. For dedicated/lane add-on we need an infra cost estimate (expected qps and p99 tail). i'll get a calc by EOD.
Liz Kline: product note: launch criteria must include (1) billing wiring for add-ons in self-serve, (2) contract language for trial softcap, (3) 3 customer pilots signed.
Emma Chen: agreed. propose must-have list: [billing for add-ons in console, burst policy doc, SLA baseline + credit formula]. nice-to-have: priority lane pilot, per-route throttles UI, automated invoice templates.
Ajay Patel: question: for SLA credit formula do we do % of monthly invoice or fixed token credit? customers prefer tokens for predictability.
Marco Ruiz: ops perspective — token credits are easier to automate in billing system. % of invoice requires more legal checks.
Liz Kline: legal flagged extreme edge cases for % refunds. tokens also align with usage-based model. prefer tokens.
Emma Chen: decision: go tokens for initial launch. note for roadmap: evaluate %-refund option in Q3 after 3 pilots.
ops-bot: deploy: /update checklist "midmarket-tier-launch" -> billing-bundle:in-progress, sla-spec:done
Ajay Patel: can we define burst policy short text for docs? draft: "Burst window = 5 min sustained above baseline. Overages billed at burst-rate until return to baseline or end of window." thoughts?
Marco Ruiz: tweak: "Burst window = 5-minute sliding window. Billed at burst-rate per token; if sustained beyond 1 hour, automated invite to sales for dedicated capacity."
Liz Kline: add safeguard: "system may throttle to protect SLOs; customers will be notified 1st time per billing cycle."
Emma Chen: LGTM. action items: Marco — infra cost calc + suggestion for burst-rate by tomorrow. Ajay — write short doc blurb for docs site and sample billing line items. Liz — update contract appendix with token-credit SLA and notification clause. I'll own launch gating checklist and pilot outreach.
Marco Ruiz: noted.
Ajay Patel: pinging @sales for pilot candidates after doc draft.
Emma Chen: thanks team :thumbsup: — keeping this thread as canonical for launch decisions.
